description: Express.js route handlers for AI-related endpoints, including chat, quiz, assignment, and feedback functionalities, with role-based access control and database interactions.

methods.name: isAnthropicAuthError
methods.description: Checks if an error is related to Anthropic API authentication issues.

methods.name: isValidId
methods.description: Validates if a raw input is a positive integer ID.

methods.name: isLearner
methods.description: Determines if a role string corresponds to a learner.

methods.name: isInstructor
methods.description: Determines if a role string corresponds to an instructor, admin, or manager.
